reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis proposes a processing route to increase strength, but it does not address the research question of why the simple solid-solution state has low hardness and strength; it instead describes how to make a different, stronger material.
reasons.testability: The falsification test only checks if the new processed material is hard, which does not test the proposed mechanism for the low strength of the starting simple solid-solution state.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is off-topic, as it proposes a strengthening method rather than explaining the deformation behavior and low strength of the equimolar solid-solution state as requested.
